overview: Centripetal force is a real, inward force in an inertial frame; centrifugal force is an outward pseudo-force that only appears in a rotating (non-inertial) reference frame.
genZNote: Centripetal force is real and inward. Centrifugal force is just what it feels like from inside the spin.

aspects.label: Real or Pseudo Force?
aspects.valueA: Real force, provided by tension/gravity/friction/normal reaction.
aspects.valueB: Pseudo (fictitious) force, appears only in a rotating reference frame.

aspects.label: Direction
aspects.valueA: Directed towards the centre of the circular path.

aspects.label: Reference Frame
aspects.valueB: Only 'felt'/observed from within the rotating (non-inertial) frame.
